Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

REQUEST TEST: Chest_XRay

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That X-ray suggests emphysema or chronic bronchitis; have you ever been diagnosed with COPD, and do you smoke or have a history of heavy secondhand smoke exposure?

REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: FEV1: 65% of predicted, FVC: 75% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio: 0.60 (decreased)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease), likely with an emphysema component given the hyperinflation and FEV1/FVC ratio.
